decisions.decision_needed: All members accept the documented MVP
Provider, endpoint, exact model ID, API revision and capabilities
decisions.value: Current default: provider claude_code, which calls the local Claude Code CLI in print mode with the user's existing sign-in, model claude-sonnet-5-5, tools disabled, no session saved (user instruction 2026-11-07, for testing until the user adds their own model API). Alternatives already built: anthropic (official SDK with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and openai_compatible (hosted endpoint). Switch in config/settings.toml [model]. The claude_code provider is not available inside Docker.
decisions.hosted_option: 2026-11-17 user instruction: host Qwen on the user's own Colab Pro+ GPU and use it for the agents. colab/qwen_vllm_server.ipynb serves Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with vLLM (OpenAI-compatible, json_schema structured output, hermes tool-call parser) behind an API-key gateway and a cloudflared quick tunnel. Selected per machine through EXPENSE_MODEL_* overrides in .env (provider openai_compatible); settings.toml keeps claude_code as the default. There is no 5B Qwen; the 4B Instruct-2507 model matches the course notebook. Text-only: supports_vision=false, so M4 receipt reading needs a separate vision decision.

decisions.decision_needed: Supplied vision or permitted OCR API and version
decisions.value: Claude Sonnet vision through the same model adapter; capability flag model.supports_vision.
decisions.update_2026_11_18: User decision: no vision model. Receipts are reviewed from TEXT only (typed or pasted, text files, digital PDFs read with pypdf, which is not OCR). Receipt images are stored but never read; image requests return UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE and offer transcription. The corpus likewise uses only documents with a text layer.

decisions.decision_needed: Course permission, endpoint, model/revision and dimension
decisions.value: Option B: local FastEmbed BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d, ONNX on CPU, no API cost) as a stand-in. Hybrid retrieval = BM25 + vectors fused with reciprocal rank fusion; filters run before both. Switch to the hosted embedding API by setting [embeddings].provider = "openai_compatible", base_url and model_id in config/settings.toml and the key named by api_key_env in .env. Spec deviation (no local models/embeddings) approved by the user. If vectors fail, retrieval degrades to disclosed bm25_only.
decisions.hosted_option: 2026-11-17 user instruction: when the Colab-hosted embeddings endpoint (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on GPU, same model as the local stand-in) is configured through EXPENSE_EMBEDDINGS_* overrides, it is probed once at API startup; if it does not answer, [embeddings].fallback_provider = "fastembed" uses the local model for that run and /ready reports fallback_reason. No mid-run switching, because vectors from different providers are not mixed in one index.

standing_requirements: The final deliverable is a fully functional app, not fixtures or a demo shell.
Model provider, endpoint, model ID and key are configuration, so an externally hosted model can replace Claude Sonnet.
Travel search takes user-entered details in the UI and calls a configurable external travel API.
Administrators can add policy documents that are searchable and queryable through RAG; the feature is limited to the admin role.
open_items: GT028 (held-out) fails: retrieval misses P09, so receipt_required is not stated. Left untuned to protect the held-out split.
Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TRAVEL_API_KEY placeholder lines to .env.example (assistant has no read access to that file).
Docker base image pinned to python:3.14.10-slim@sha256:af8a5aa14780025dbfbcfbc81bd8a91ebd87711dd5b0f48ed71090949dd7cb1d (linux/arm64 build verified; amd64 not built).
Hosted embedding endpoint not yet supplied; local FastEmbed stand-in in use. Re-embedding happens automatically on provider/model change (cache key includes the model).

Colab-hosted Qwen endpoint (colab/qwen_vllm_server.ipynb) is built and its gateway is tested offline only; it has not yet been run on a Colab GPU or measured against the M3 policy cases. The tunnel URL changes every Colab session, so .env must be updated and the API restarted each time.

FIXED 2026-11-18 (user approved; see CHANGELOG: Government of India questions now use only GoI references). Defect (2026-11-18):questions about another organisation's rules (Government of India references, now ingested) are answered with SPARKS registry facts. Example: central government TA claim deadline answered as 30 days (SPARKS P13) instead of sixty days (GoI order R03). Proposed fix: the policy answer must scope SPARKS registry facts to SPARKS employees and answer other-organisation questions only from reference evidence, clearly labelled as not SPARKS policy; then re-run the M3 policy cases live.

Library ingested by user instruction (2026-11-18): 1 core policy + 4 SPARKS guidance + 8 GoI text references = 13 documents, 76 sections (scripts/ingest_documents.py, corpus/ingest_plan.json); conference guidance left for manual upload.

Corpus: user decision 2026-11-18, text-only. The 8 Government of India orders with a text layer are kept in corpus/india_references; the 18 scans are marked excluded and their PDFs were moved to runtime/corpus_excluded (not shipped). Nothing is ingested until the 'corpus' decision is approved.

Windows machine with Smart App Control: requirements.lock.txt pins pandas 3.1.1, pyarrow 26.0.1 and a jiter build whose DLLs are blocked; the local .venv uses pandas 3.0.2, pyarrow 22.0.0 and jiter 0.11.1 instead (lockfile unchanged; setup owner to decide).
Scanned (image-only) PDFs are rejected: OCR is not permitted, so uploads need a text layer.

Group B: out-of-spec features excluded (quarterly allowance, persona switcher, command palette and shortcuts, notifications, submit for approval, case IDs, export PDF, AI auto-adjust, exception drafting, partner hotels, AI confidence, OCR bounding boxes, rail and car rental, chat attachments, dietary and accessibility fields, per-diem and alcohol content). policy_upload_rag.decided: 2026-11-10 by user instruction ("the moment policy document is uploaded it should chunk the document & create vectors")
policy_upload_rag.pipeline: LangChain BaseLoader (pypdf/docx2txt) -> MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter + RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (1800/200, start_index) -> SQLite chunks -> embeddings (cached per model) -> InMemoryVectorStore + BM25 -> RRF
policy_upload_rag.langchain_community: Not used: archived (read-only) June 2026. Loaders are our own classes on langchain-core BaseLoader.
policy_upload_rag.out_of_scope: Retrieval preview/debug view not added (not in spec).
policy_upload_rag.caps: Uploaded documents are searchable and citable only; calculation caps always come from the rule registry (AC21).
